eyebrow: Placing a VM in a Set
code:
az vm availability-set create \
  --resource-group rg-web-prod \
  --name avset-web \
  --platform-fault-domain-count 2 \
  --platform-update-domain-count 5

az vm create --resource-group rg-web-prod \
  --name vm-web02 --availability-set avset-web ...
caption: Protects against a rack or maintenance reboot — not the whole datacenter.

eyebrow: Placing a VM in a Zone
code:
az vm create \
  --resource-group rg-web-prod \
  --name vm-web03 \
  --image Ubuntu2204 \
  --size Standard_D2s_v5 \
  --zone 1 \
  --admin-username azureuser \
  --generate-ssh-keys
caption: --zone pins the VM to a physically separate datacenter in the region.
